name: Ekiin de Ikou!
source:
Main character works at a railroad. He does his best bot at work and love, but his interest are much more perverted. One day he is called by his name. Why does this man know his name? He is going to find something important or get drawn in the world of sensual pleasures. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在铁路部门工作。他努力兼顾工作与恋爱，但兴趣却更加变态。一天，有人叫出了他的名字。这个人为什么知道他的名字？他究竟会发现重要的东西，还是会被卷入感官享乐的世界？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
